topic: ADHD: the full picture, protocol (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
A questionnaire alone is not an ADHD assessment.

The Australian ADHD guideline says a diagnosis should not rest on rating scales alone. Our adult assessment looks at your history back to childhood, your health and sleep, daily life, and input from someone who knows you, if you choose.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile. Kew, Croydon and online. Learn more at equalpsychology.com.au/services/adhd

Research:
Australian ADHD Professionals Association. (2022). Australian evidence-based clinical practice guideline for ADHD. https://adhdguideline.aadpa.com.au/
